title: The Sermon on the Mount
subtitle: Matthew 5–7 section by section, with the Law Jesus cites, Luke's parallels, and the echoes in the apostles
summary: Jesus went up the mountain, sat down, and taught: the character of the kingdom's people, the true depth of the Law, the secret life of giving, prayer and fasting, and the two roads. This study walks through Matthew 5 to 7 in order. Zoom into a saying to see the text Jesus was answering, where Luke records the same teaching, and how James, Peter, Paul and John repeat it.
